jobs.subject: Three compact angular copper-rich rocks fused into one small ore cluster; dark stone with broad dull copper mineral veins. Do not show refined copper bars.
A compact handful-sized cluster of three pale frosted quartz gravel chunks with angular translucent edges and warm gray stone inclusions. No gemstone jewelry.
A compact cluster of three rounded black carbon nodules, rough matte charcoal surfaces with a few broad facets. Distinct from angular metal ore; no burning or glow.
A short stack of exactly three structural steel channels, thick dark brushed steel U-section bars with visible open ends, bound by one copper strap.
One squat reel of thick copper conductor wire with a single short loose end, charcoal steel spool cheeks and an ivory ceramic center hub.
A small offset stack of three thick ivory ceramic substrate plates, broad square silhouette, a few mounting holes, charcoal edges and unprinted surfaces.
One precision polished pale blue-gray optical crystal prism, chunky hexagonal cut, broad clear facets, held at its base by a small charcoal transport clip. No glow.
A rectangular ivory ceramic circuit carrier with three broad copper traces and two chunky dark electronic packages. Distinct exposed board silhouette, simple industrial electronics, no tiny writing.
A compact square industrial service connector block: steel flange, one round copper electrical socket, two small ceramic-lined service sockets, short keyed locking latch. Not a machine.
One squat sealed industrial coolant charge cartridge: ivory ceramic cylinder in a charcoal protective cage, copper screw cap, one narrow subdued teal liquid sight window. No lettering.
One short thick copper coolant pipe elbow with bolted charcoal flanges on both ends and an ivory ceramic insulating collar. Clear L-shaped silhouette.
One compact open charcoal metal repair-kit case containing a spare copper coil, ivory ceramic patch plates and a chunky mechanical wrench held in fitted recesses. No medical cross.
One squat industrial sentry ammunition cassette: charcoal rectangular steel housing, three exposed dull brass cylindrical cartridge tips at one end, broad ivory ceramic locking grip. No weapon.
One thick circular pale blue-gray precision optical lens held in a dark three-lug mounting ring, ivory ceramic rim and small copper fasteners. Broad glass center, no glow.
One compact precision linear actuator: short exposed steel lead screw on a charcoal rectangular rail, ivory ceramic slider carriage at the center and copper motor winding housing at one end.
One squat resonator core: ivory ceramic cradle supporting a short faceted optical crystal between two copper end plates, all inside a compact open dark steel frame. No glowing orb.
One compact sensor head: square ivory ceramic enclosure with a single recessed dark blue optical aperture in a charcoal front bezel, copper plug at the back and small mounting foot.
One active optical gain core: short thick pale crystal rod held inside an open copper cooling jacket with three prominent fins and ivory ceramic end supports. No glow or energy beam.
One pulse capacitor module: two stout charcoal cylindrical canisters on a shared ivory ceramic base, broad copper bus bridge and recessed terminals. No electrical arcs.
One plain thin charcoal semiconductor wafer disk with a single orientation notch, subtle blue-gray reflection and no patterned circuitry. Bare unmounted wafer; no carrier ring.
One sealed small patterning-resist bottle: squat dark amber body, thick ivory ceramic cap, charcoal protective base and one plain copper collar. No printed label.
One square dark semiconductor die with a broad readable cross-shaped copper photonic pattern and simple stepped edge contacts, sitting on a thin ivory ceramic backing.
One small right-angle optical coupler: ivory ceramic L-shaped block carrying a pale glass aperture on one end and a short dark chip interface on the other, with a single copper retaining clip.

One packaged photonic module: rectangular charcoal metal housing with ivory ceramic lid, two small recessed pale optical ports on one short edge and four broad copper electrical contacts on the other.

One compact paired transmitter-receiver communication module in a shared charcoal chassis with twin ivory ceramic covers, two recessed optical apertures and a copper interconnect bridge. No radio waves or antenna effects.

One short straight restricted-mode optical conduit: ivory ceramic tube with faceted dark optical core visible at one cut end, broad charcoal coupling collars and a small copper clamp. Not an electrical cable.
One short constructible conveyor belt segment: four broad charcoal rubber slats between low steel rails, two exposed copper-toned rollers underneath. Single isolated modular piece.

One accepted lightsail membrane panel folded loosely over a thin rectangular support frame: pale silver translucent film with a restrained fine grid, one broad reflective fold and small charcoal corner tabs. No spacecraft.

One compact inspected flight sail stowed as a neatly folded silver membrane bundle in a slim ivory ceramic transport cassette with copper restraint straps. The inventory object is stowed, not a deployed spacecraft.

A low compact belt splitter, single central rubber-belt inlet splitting into two short parallel outlet lanes, chunky charcoal steel body, ivory ceramic side housings and copper roller ends. Show all three belt mouths; no carried items.

A compact coolant pump on a square bolted steel skid: squat ivory ceramic motor housing, offset copper centrifugal volute and two clearly distinct short flanged coolant connections. No reservoir or pipes leaving the footprint.

A squat closed-loop heat exchanger on a rectangular steel base: broad bank of copper radiator fins, one large horizontal dark fan on top, ivory ceramic side guards and two short capped coolant flanges. No steam.

A compact industrial monitor station: low square bolted base, a single backward-tilted dark unlit instrument screen in an ivory ceramic housing, recessed copper sampling interface and a short vertical back panel. No text on screen.

A small passive branch probe on a low steel mounting foot: chunky ivory ceramic sensing block enclosing a dark optical aperture, copper retaining clamp and one small recessed sample socket. No beams or display.

A short sturdy industrial power distribution pole on a broad square bolted foundation, charcoal metal mast, ivory ceramic insulators on a compact crossarm and copper terminal clamps. No attached wires extending outside its silhouette.
